remarks: Beautifully Renovated 4-Bedroom Home with Modern Upgrades & Spacious Layout Be the first to enjoy this freshly remodeled three-level home, featuring over $40,000 in recent renovations. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this property combines modern finishes with the comfort and privacy of a single-family residence. The home offers 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, with a flexible third-floor layout that spans the entire level-perfect as a private primary suite or home office. Enjoy brand-new hardwood flooring on the second and third floors, complemented by durable new vinyl flooring on the first level. Every room is enhanced with upgraded LED lighting, creating a bright, energy-efficient living environment. Additional features include washer/dryer on the first floor and a well-designed multi-level layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Located in a mixed-use building, the residential space maintains a quiet, single-family feel, with neighboring businesses operating only during standard daytime hours-ensuring peace and privacy in the evenings and weekends. Key Features: Fully renovated with over $40K in upgrades 4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, Flexible third-floor living space .New hardwood & vinyl flooring throughout. Energy-efficient LED lighting Quiet setting with minimal after-hours activity
